async def main():
    player1_wins = 0
    player2_wins = 0
    round_num = 0
    
    print("=== DICE GAME: First to 3 Wins ===\n")
    
    # Play until one player wins 3 rounds
    while player1_wins < 3 and player2_wins < 3:
        round_num += 1
        print(f"--- Round {round_num} ---")

        player1_roll = await rollDie({"player": "player1"})
        player2_roll = await rollDie({"player": "player2"})
        
        # Extract the numeric values from the results
        p1_value = int(player1_roll.strip())
        p2_value = int(player2_roll.strip())
        
        print(f"Player 1 rolls: {p1_value}")
        print(f"Player 2 rolls: {p2_value}")
        
        # Determine round winner
        if p1_value > p2_value:
            player1_wins += 1
            print(f"Player 1 wins this round!")
        elif p2_value > p1_value:
            player2_wins += 1
            print(f"Player 2 wins this round!")
        else:
            print(f"Draw! No one gets a point.")
        
        print(f"Score: Player 1 = {player1_wins}, Player 2 = {player2_wins}\n")
    
    # Announce the game winner
    print("=" * 40)
    if player1_wins == 3:
        print(f"🏆 GAME OVER: Player 1 wins the game! (3-{player2_wins})")
    else:
        print(f"🏆 GAME OVER: Player 2 wins the game! (3-{player1_wins})")
    print("=" * 40)
    
    # Determine who was cheating based on the results
    print("\n📊 Analysis:")
    print(f"Total rounds played: {round_num}")
    if player1_wins > player2_wins:
        print("Player 1 had better results - likely using the loaded die! 🎲")
    elif player2_wins > player1_wins:
        print("Player 2 had better results - likely using the loaded die! 🎲")
    else:
        print("Results were even - hard to determine who was cheating from this game alone.")

asyncio.run(main())
